evidence: Fuzzing label and changes exclusively modify the fuzz harness in `src/test/fuzz/http_request.cpp`.
rationale: Expands fuzz harness coverage for the HTTP request parsing state machine across chunked I/O boundaries and raises the input limit to reach `MAX_HEADERS_SIZE`. As noted in the description, 'the target parses the whole input in one pass, so the paths that resume a partly-read request are unreachable from it', making this worthwhile coverage for parser edge cases without touching high-risk consensus or p2p paths.
